prevention_change.evidence: parseCoffeeAdditionIntent now delegates interpretation to parseMealCommandFromWhatsApp and only projects the coffee-specific partial state; the handler no longer reparses to compensate.

detection_change.evidence: Regression compares specialized output with the canonical parser across literal, sibling, partial, and unsupported-unit cases and asserts no duplicate action vocabulary in the specialized parser.
